items.html: But the matter is that it was explained above that even though ZA clothes Arich Anpin from the half of the Tifferet within it and below, he does not clothe it by itself, but only after Arich Anpin is clothed with the aspects mentioned within the NHY of Aba, which spread until there, and the NHY of Aba are clothed in the NHY of Ima; then ZA clothes the NHY of Ima.
